title: ClimateFish: visual-census counts of 15 coastal fish species on 3142 transects at 183 locations x depth layers, Mediterranean Sea, 2009-2021
creator: Azzurro, Ernesto; Ballerini, Tosca; Antoniadou, Chryssanthi; et al. (ClimateFish network)
citation: Azzurro E, Ballerini T, Antoniadou C, et al. (2022). ClimateFish: Abundance of selected coastal fish species as candidate indicators of climate change in the Mediterranean Sea. SEANOE. https://doi.org/10.17882/86784
abstract: ClimateFish collaborative monitoring of 15 coastal fish species chosen as candidate indicators of climate change in the Mediterranean (7 native, 8 non-indigenous, among them Siganus luridus, S. rivulatus and Pterois miles). Divers count every target species on four consecutive five-minute transects (about 50 x 5 m) per location and depth layer (0-3, 5-10, 11-20, 21-30 m). 3142 transects at 102 locations in 8 countries, 2009-2021. One row per transect and species, y = individuals counted; the unit is a location x depth layer, the period a calendar month, the occasion a transect within it.
samplingProtocol: Simplified underwater visual census: at each location and depth layer a diver swims four consecutive replicate transects of five minutes at about 10 m/min (about 50 x 5 m), counting all individuals of 15 target species (Azzurro et al. 2022, after Garrabou et al. 2019).
closureNote: Replicate transects are swum consecutively on one dive in most unit-months; a few unit-months combine transects from different days of the month (date shows which), and 457 transects are dated to the month only.
geographicCoverage: Mediterranean Sea: Malta, Italy, Croatia, Spain, France, Greece, Tunisia, Cyprus (coordinates coarsened to 0.1 degree)

coordinatesCoarsened.method: Location coordinates (5 decimals) coarsened to the 0.1 degree cell centre with coarsen_coords(): Epinephelus marginatus (dusky grouper) is IUCN VU and native to the Mediterranean.

notes: Counts of target species only (taxonInclusion = target). Most unit-months have four transects; 57 have eight (two divers or two sets) and a few fewer than four. obs_team is the contributing institution (20). Non-indigenous status of each species is taxon_mediterranean_status in the taxa side table (from the paper).

notShipped.exact_coordinates: coarsened to 0.1 degree (Epinephelus marginatus, IUCN VU)
